title.zh: 半导体工艺入行，先学懂这9件事
title.en: Entering semiconductor processing: first understand these nine topics

body.zh: 01 全流程地图；先找到工艺位置，再学习单步
body.en: 01 Full-process map Locate the process step before learning it

body.zh: Wafer；FEOL；MOL；BEOL；WAT /；Package
body.en: Wafer FEOL MOL BEOL WAT / Package

body.zh: 全局视角| 位置感 | 学习路径
body.en: Global view, process location, learning path

body.zh: 02 晶圆与膜层；看懂材料堆栈，才能看懂工艺
body.en: 02 Wafers and films Understand the stack to understand the process

body.zh: 金属层（Cu）；阻挡层（Ta/TaN）；介质层（SiO₂）；氮化层（Si₃N₄）；硅衬底（Si）
body.en: Metal layer (Cu) Barrier layer (Ta/TaN) Dielectric layer (SiO₂) Nitride layer (Si₃N₄) Silicon substrate (Si)

body.zh: 材料堆栈 | 功能 |界面
body.en: Material stack, function, interface

body.zh: 03 图形转移；光刻定义图形，刻蚀写进材料
body.en: 03 Pattern transfer Lithography defines patterns; etching writes them into materials

body.zh: 掩模（Mask）；光刻胶（Resist）；刻蚀后（Etch）
body.en: Mask Photoresist After etch

body.zh: 光刻| 刻蚀 | 选择性
body.en: Lithography, etching, selectivity

body.zh: 04 薄膜工程；沉积不只需要控制厚度
body.en: 04 Thin-film engineering Deposition requires more than thickness control

body.zh: PVD；CVD；ALD
body.en: PVD CVD ALD

body.zh: 覆盖良好（Conformal）
body.en: Good conformality (Conformal)

body.zh: 膜厚均匀性（Wafer Map）
body.en: Film-thickness uniformity (Wafer Map)

body.zh: 沉积方式 | 覆盖性 | 均匀性
body.en: Deposition method, coverage, uniformity

body.zh: 05 掺杂与热预算；注入剂量不等于有效掺杂
body.en: 05 Doping and thermal budget Implanted dose is not effective doping

body.zh: 离子注入；（Ion Implant）；掺杂分布；（Profile）；退火；（Anneal）
body.en: Ion implantation (Ion Implant) Dopant profile (Profile) Annealing (Anneal)
B⁺ 10²¹ B⁺ 10¹⁹ Concentration 10¹⁷ 10¹⁵ 0 50 100 150 Depth (nm)

body.zh: 剂量 | 激活 | 扩散 | 热预算
body.en: Dose, activation, diffusion, thermal budget

body.zh: 06 清洗与平坦化；表面状态决定下一步稳定性
body.en: 06 Cleaning and planarization Surface condition determines next-step stability

body.zh: 清洗；（Clean）；填充薄膜；（Fill）；CMP；抛光；平坦表面；（Planar）
body.en: Cleaning (Clean) Film fill (Fill) CMP Polishing Planar surface (Planar)

body.zh: 颗粒 | 残留 | 表面粗糙度
body.en: Particles, residue, surface roughness

body.zh: 07 工艺窗口；参数不是越大越好
body.en: 07 Process window Larger parameter values are not always better

body.zh: Power；（功率）；Pressure；（压力）；Gas；（气体流量）；Temperature；（温度）
body.en: Power (power) Pressure (pressure) Gas (gas flow) Temperature (temperature)

body.zh: 工艺窗口；（Process Window）；最佳区域；可接受区；风险区；参数A
body.en: Process window (Process Window) Optimal region Acceptable region Risk region Parameter A

body.zh: 参数联动| 窗口 | 风险控制
body.en: Parameter coupling, window, risk control

body.zh: 08 量测与良率；没有反馈，就没有量产工艺
body.en: 08 Metrology and yield Without feedback, there is no production-ready process

body.zh: 量测；缺陷地图；（Metrology）；（Defect Map）；SPC；控制图；WAT/良率；（Yield）
body.en: Metrology Defect map (Metrology) (Defect Map) SPC Control chart WAT / yield (Yield)

body.zh: UCL；良率；95.2%；良好；可疑；缺陷
body.en: UCL Yield 95.2% Good Suspect Defect

body.zh: 量测|统计| 控制|良率提升
body.en: Metrology, statistics, control, yield improvement

body.zh: 09 岗位与解题；异常处理依靠跨岗位证据链
body.en: 09 Roles and problem solving Troubleshooting relies on an evidence chain across roles

body.zh: 工艺；（Process）；良率；（Yield）；设备；（Equipment）；证据链；（Evidence Chain）；失效分析；（PIE）
body.en: Process (Process) Yield (Yield) Equipment (Equipment) Evidence chain (Evidence Chain) Failure analysis (PIE)

body.zh: 协同 | 证据 | 闭环 | 快速定位
body.en: Collaboration, evidence, closed loop, fast localization

body.zh: 低
body.en: Low

body.zh: 参数B
body.en: Parameter B

body.zh: LCL
body.en: LCL
